against.head: A descending triangle
against.text: Buyers have held the same floor twice while each bounce stops lower: pressure building on the floor.

against.head: Resistance +0.3% above
against.text: The nearest ceiling is +0.3% above (0.1 ATR), where 8 levels (3 kinds) meet: the Jan 22 high, the 50-week average and the 38.2% retracement of the Oct 16–Oct 29 rise: little room before sellers have stepped in before.

material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the February breakout level, the average price paid since the Oct 16 low and the 61.8% retracement of the Oct 16–Oct 29 rise, where 12 levels (5 kinds) meet.

material.head: Selling is losing force
material.text: A lower low in price (Nov 5) against a higher low in momentum (7 of 7 gauges): regular bullish divergence.
material.learn: Lower price lows with rising momentum lows: sellers are tiring.

material.head: A possible double bottom
material.text: It bottomed twice at one level (Oct 16 and Nov 5); a close above the peak between them confirms the double bottom.
material.learn: Two lows at one price with a peak between; the pattern counts once price closes over that peak.

material.head: Holding its rising 20-day
material.text: It dipped to its rising 20-day average in the last three sessions and held above it.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

material.head: Next support −3.4% below
material.text: The next floor under it is −3.4% below (1.6 ATR): the December 2025 breakout level, the Oct 16 low and the Nov 5 low.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.

against.text: On Nov 12 it opened over the prior close and closed under the prior open: sellers took the day back in full.
against.learn: A session whose body swallows the one before: one side has taken over.

against.head: A thin rise
against.text: Volume on the current rise runs 50% below its 50-day average: few buyers behind it.
against.learn: A rise on heavy volume has buyers behind it; a thin rise often fades.

against.head: Weekly: a pullback that is not done
against.text: The pullback from the Sep 3 high is not done: it has not reached the 0.5 retracement, it is one straight leg and it is too quick for the advance before it. A wave 2 usually unfolds in three waves and reaches the 0.618–0.786 of the Mar 24, 2023–Sep 3 advance (−30% to −39%).
against.learn: A real wave 2 takes three waves and time, on lighter volume. Too shallow, too quick, one straight leg or rising selling says it has further to go.

material.head: Weekly chart: advancing

material.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

material.head: Retesting its breakout level
